name: Temuco

queries.query: Temuco Chile official cadastral parcel map GIS predios cadastre municipalidad Temuco
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Municipalidad de Temuco interactive parcel/address plan, the official IDE Temuco ArcGIS REST directory, and the municipal Catastro/DOM references. The public directory exposed an anonymous parcel geocoder but no public parcel-polygon feature layer.

queries.query: Temuco Chile mapa predial catastro parcelas sitio oficial
queries.result: Spanish first-party discovery identified the municipal interactive parcel/address plan and the municipal IDE. The official ArcGIS directory describes Geolocalizador_Predios as a role geolocator for parcels in the Temuco commune, but the exposed service is GeocodeServer and did not provide an anonymous polygon response.

officialSources.observation: Official Municipalidad de Temuco page for the interactive parcel and address plan; the accessible page body contains only the placeholder acceso_pagina_enlaces.php, so the embedded viewer configuration was not exposed in this fetch.

Official municipal ArcGIS metadata describes a monthly-updated geolocator of parcel roles in the Temuco commune, with Geocode/ReverseGeocode/Suggest capabilities and native spatial reference WKID 32718. It is a geocoder, not a parcel polygon feature service.

Official municipal transparency page identifies Departamento de Catastro within the Dirección de Obras Municipales and assigns it municipal cadastral cartography/database and certificate functions. This is local custodian evidence, distinct from general national-agency prose.
Official IDE Temuco REST root listed CATASTRO and ESTUDIOS folders. Anonymous CATASTRO folder inspection returned Token Required; ESTUDIOS listed the parcel GeocodeServer.

requests.outcome: Returned the official REST root and listed CATASTRO, ESTUDIOS and other folders.
ArcGIS JSON response was error code 499 Token Required. No login, token, credential or bypass was attempted; this route did not expose service metadata.
Listed the official parcel GeocodeServer and other ESTUDIOS services.

Returned service metadata: parcel-role geolocator description, Geocode/ReverseGeocode/Suggest capabilities, and WKID 32718. No parcel polygon layer, safe native ID field schema, or polygon geometry was returned.
Anonymous bounded geocoder request returned an empty candidates array. This is not a parcel-polygon query and is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
Official page loaded, but its content exposed a placeholder rather than a viewer URL or JavaScript configuration. No browser automation, login, CAPTCHA bypass or private token was used.

registryBasis: The official Municipalidad de Temuco transparency page evidences a local Departamento de Catastro within the Dirección de Obras Municipales, and the official municipal IDE exposes a parcel-role geolocator for the Temuco commune. This establishes local cadastral custody/public mapping infrastructure, not an open parcel-polygon adapter.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Temuco commune parcel-role geolocator and municipal cadastral mapping.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local custodian and anonymous geocoder metadata only; no city-bounded parcel polygon response was verified.

crs: Service metadata reports EPSG:32718 / WGS 84 UTM zone 18S for the geocoder; no parcel polygon CRS was verified.

The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used to infer presence/absence.
